judge_notes.opus55: Q3 same-store sales were pre-signalled above 3% and should land in guide. Sell-side cuts lowered the bar, and short interest is about 22-26% of the real float. The QSR peer weakness is already in the put skew.
judge_notes.sonnet55: QTD comp above 3%, conservative EBITDA guide and a pre-cut sell-side bar with short interest high on the real float, against QSR peer weakness and downside-paid skew.
judge_notes.fable51: Q3 comp pre-signalled above 3% with 10 of 13 weeks in, the sell-side has pre-cut targets, the EBITDA floor looks conservative and the short is 22-26% of the real float; the QSR-consumer proxy risk to the Q4 comp is the counterweight.
